user.description: Choose the Cloud RO to add.

abort.already_configured: This Cloud RO is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No Cloud RO found. Close the Cloud phone app (the filter is invisible while the app is connected to it) and make sure a connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy is in range.

data_description.poll_interval: How often to connect to the filter and read it. Each poll uses some of the filter's battery and briefly blocks the phone app from connecting.
